## Description

Optimizes multi-asset allocation weights by training a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty on return scenarios, ensuring robustness against non-Gaussian distributional shifts.

## Where it may fit

Fat-tailed multi-asset allocation, extreme market stress scenarios, non-Gaussian portfolio optimization.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Risk Management Groups, Multi-Asset Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Multivariate historical return series across equity, fixed income, and commodities.

## Caveats

Discriminator and generator training balance requires rigorous hyperparameter tuning to avoid divergence.
